primitives.note: Q fires 5 Stone Shards over 1.5s (each a separately timed hit), and can be recast while standing in the Worked Ground it creates to fire an empowered Boulder instead
Subsequent Stone Shard hits on the same target within one cast deal only 40% damage; the Boulder deals 180% damage to its primary target
Casting Q while standing in self-created Worked Ground consumes it, reducing that cast's cooldown by 50% (floor 0.75s) and its cost to 10 mana
Mana costs (Q 55-75 or 10 empowered, E 90 flat) meaningfully cap casts inside a 15s fight
Stones scatter and deal magic damage on eruption, then remain 4s as a slowing zone that can be detonated for further damage
A target can detonate up to 4 stones per cast, with the detonation damage falling off per additional stone detonated
E's detonation damage only triggers if the target dashes or is knocked airborne into a stone; against a stationary dummy this requires Taliyah to actively use W to knock it into the field

needsBespoke.why: Taliyah's Q creates a self-positioned 400-radius 'Worked Ground' zone at her own cast location. If she is still standing in it when she casts Q again, that cast is consumed and empowered (higher damage, 10 mana, cooldown halved to a 0.75s floor). This is a location-gated recast trigger tied to her own position rather than to a target or a simple timer/stack, and the closed primitive list has no entry for 'own self-created zone gates the next cast's power level.' The closest primitives (recast-or-multipart, cooldown-manipulation) capture the mechanical effect once triggered but not the positional precondition or whether the empowered cast itself refreshes the zone for a subsequent empowered cast.

unsettled.question: Does casting the empowered Boulder (Q consumed on Worked Ground) also drop a new Worked Ground patch under Taliyah, allowing her to chain empowered Q casts indefinitely, or does empowerment only consume terrain without creating new terrain (forcing alternation between a normal cast that plants ground and an empowered cast that consumes it)?
options: Every Q cast (normal or empowered) creates a fresh Worked Ground patch at her location, so a stationary Taliyah can spam empowered Q on cooldown indefinitely
Only the normal (non-empowered) cast creates Worked Ground; the empowered cast consumes it without replacing it, so casts must alternate normal/empowered
quotes: Casting ''Threaded Volley'' creates an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}} at '''Taliyah's''' cast location that has a radius of 400 units and lasts 30 seconds. While '''Taliyah''' is within an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}}, ''Threaded Volley's'' cast consumes the area to become empowered

unsettled.question: In the single-target dummy fight, does E's detonation damage ever trigger, given the dummy never dashes and is never airborne unless Taliyah deliberately knocks it up with W first? If so, should the rotation spend a W cast (with its ~0.79s eruption delay and mana cost) purely to set up E's detonation bonus damage?
options: Detonation damage is unreachable against a passive dummy and should be excluded from the damage fight entirely (only E's scatter damage counts)
Taliyah should cast W to knock the dummy through the stone field, triggering detonation damage as part of the optimal rotation
quotes: Enemies that {{tip|dash}} or are {{tip|airborne|knocked}} over a stone will detonate it, taking {{as|magic damage}} and becoming {{tip|stun|stunned}}

proposal: Open by casting E (Unraveled Earth) into the target for the scatter magic damage and to lay down a 4-second stone field.

Cast Q (Threaded Volley), which barrages 5 Stone Shards over 1.5s at the target and drops Worked Ground under Taliyah's feet; weave in a basic attack once the third Stone Shard has launched if attack speed allows.
Immediately recast Q while still standing in her own Worked Ground to fire the empowered Boulder for bonus primary-target damage at reduced cost and cooldown.
Continue recasting Q every time it comes off cooldown for the rest of the fight, taking the empowered version whenever standing in unused Worked Ground.
Recast E again once its 14s cooldown is up (roughly once more before the ~15s fight ends).
Do not cast R (Weaver's Wall): it deals no damage, only knocks back and builds terrain, which is irrelevant against a stationary dummy with CC ignored.
Cast W only if it is established that doing so is needed to knock the dummy through E's stone field to trigger detonation damage; otherwise skip it to save mana and tempo for Q casts.
questions: Does the simulator assume Taliyah stays planted at her cast location for the whole fight (never repositioning), so she is always standing inside her own Worked Ground when Q comes off cooldown?
Should W be included in the optimal rotation purely to enable E's detonation damage against an otherwise-immobile dummy, or is that damage source meant to be unreachable in this fight format?

If Worked Ground does not regenerate on an empowered cast, what is the correct alternating pattern (normal, empowered, normal, empowered...) versus casting Q on cooldown with the standard (non-reduced) cooldown between empowered casts?
